newsitem.title: GERMANY: Waigel - latest data could be positive for deficit.
newsitem.headline: Waigel - latest data could be positive for deficit.

text.p: German Finance Minister Theo Waigel said on Thursday that the latest economic indicators in Germany were more positive and could have a beneficial effect on the deficit.

Asked what he thought about Thursday's first quarter gross domestic product (GDP) data, Waigel told reporters: "The latest indicators are more positive, but unfortunately they are not yet impacting the labour market."
Asked how the numbers might affect Germany's efforts to ready itself for currency union, Waigel added: "The data could be positive for the deficit."
Data released earlier on Thursday showed German GDP grew 0.5 percent quarter-on-quarter in the first three months of 1997. The year-on-year growth rate was 1.4 percent.
